title: Head of Technology
description:
We are hiring a Head of Technology for the garden3d creative collective, to lead engineering at Sanctuary Computer and garden3d in the era of agentic computer code.

Original job posting link

About garden3d

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

Weâre the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer - Development

At Sanctuary Computer weâre building a different type of technology shop â one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX - Design

When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and weâve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

Weâre building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Index - Community

Index is network of physical spaces all around the world, Index provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools.

We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care.

garden3d TK â Media

At garden3d, weâre in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture.

We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music.

Plus, our partner organizations

Lightphone
Mill
IngredientAI

â°ï¸ The Head of Technology Role

The garden3d Head of Technology has one mandate: everything we build works, holds up in production, and gets built the smartest way available to us. We are a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and a lot of what all of them ship runs on software we wrote. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis, this person sets the engineering standard, and builds the culture that holds it.

You can be based anywhere. A lot of our people are in New York and there's some gravity here, but we already work across timezones and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you.

This role works with studio leads, developers, designers, project managers and clients across every garden3d vertical.

This person can move between a Rails migration, a Next.js app, a firmware release plan and an agent loop in the same week, and raise the bar on each of them.

They span all of garden3d, but their home base is Sanctuary Computer, where roughly 70% of their time goes. Our development studio is where the engineering standard gets set, and where it either holds or slips: architecture, code review, estimation, and the hardest technical calls on our biggest projects. The other 30% goes to garden3d's broader technology story: how we ship product for USB Club, build with agents across the collective, which tools and platforms we bet on, and what we build for ourselves.

They are also how we get better people. Our work is only as good as the engineers making it, so this person hunts for exceptional talent, sells them on us, and sets them up to do the best work of their careers. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, an open P&L and clients like Google, Stripe, Brooklyn Museum and The Nobel Prize, and sees an engineering practice they can propel among the best in the world.

Responsibilities & Mandates

ï¸ Systems that hold up

We build web apps, native apps, data pipelines, content platforms and connected devices for clients who can't afford for them to fall over. This person has engineered complex systems for a long time, and it shows in the architecture they draw before a line is written. They own the technical blueprint on our most important projects, and they make the hard calls on the rest: what to build, what to buy, and what to leave out.

All in on agentic development

The way software gets built changed, and we intend to be ahead of it. This person is already deep in it: loop engineering, agents running against evals, agents that open their own PRs, and the guardrails that make all of that trustworthy. They make agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer works, and they can tell the difference between a demo and a system a team can rely on.

Practical engineering

We strongly prefer convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms that let a small team ship a lot. TypeScript is the default language, Rails and Phoenix handle what they're best at, and we'd rather deploy to a platform like Render or Heroku than run our own infrastructure. This person practices value engineering: the simplest thing that works, built well, at a cost the client is glad to pay.

Code quality at Sanctuary Computer

Sanctuary Computer is where our engineering standard lives, so this is where most of their energy goes. They set what good code review looks like, keep our senior developers sharp on architecture and quality, and make sure that bar holds without slowing the team down.

Hiring and empowering the very best

They are a magnet for exceptional engineers. They know where to find them, how to convince them, and how to give them enough room to do their best work while still holding them to the standard. People who work for this person should get visibly better, and should say so.

Estimation, scoping and delivery

They make sure our teams can reliably estimate and story point the work ahead, and that we deliver at a pace that meets the dates we promised and protects our margins. When an estimate is wrong, they find out why and fix the process.

The technical voice in new business

Our clients include Google, Stripe, Figma, Mozilla and The Nobel Prize. This person joins new business calls as the trusted technical consultant, scopes the work, writes the technical side of proposals, and can explain a hard tradeoff to a client's CTO and their CEO in the same meeting.

Hardware sense

We're the software team behind The Light Phone and Mill, so a good share of our work touches devices. This person doesn't need to be a firmware engineer, but they understand how hardware works, where it constrains the software, and how to plan a project that spans both.

The garden3d technology story

Across the collective, they decide which tools and platforms we bet on, how every studio uses agents, and which internal tools are worth turning into products. When someone at garden3d asks "how should we build this?", this person has the answer, or knows who does.

Culture

They model garden3d's values of partnership, curiosity, and accountability. The engineers they lead do the best work of their careers here, because the feedback is honest, the recognition is earned, and the craft rubs off

Â Special Projects

In addition to day to day responsibilities, hereâs an idea of some of the projects this role may spearhead or support in coming years â

  • Making agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer builds, with loops and evals the whole team trusts
  • Setting the shared technical conventions every garden3d studio builds from
  • Landing the kind of flagship engineering engagement that changes what people think we do
  • Hiring the next generation of the engineering team, across every garden3d studio
  • Turning the internal tools and agents we build for ourselves into products
  • Partnering with the Head of Design so our own studio websites are as well engineered as they are designed

Qualifications

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to make a significant impact in a growing, dynamic company. Based on the responsibilities of this role, we think the right candidate has the following experience and skills:

Must have:

  • 12+ years building software, at least three of them leading engineers inside a studio, agency, startup or founder-led company
  • Deep experience engineering complex systems, shipped and run in production: distributed services, data pipelines, multi-platform products
  • A true technology generalist, comfortable across frontend, backend, data, infrastructure and native
  • A strong preference for practical engineering: convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms as a service over bespoke infrastructure
  • All in on agentic development: loop engineering, evals, and agents doing real work in a real codebase
  • Fluency across most of our stack: React, Next.js, Ruby on Rails, Elixir & Phoenix, Sanity, Postgres, Redis. You won't use all of it every week, but you should be able to review any of it
  • Experience as the technical lead in winning work: scoping, estimating and pitching to clients
  • A track record of hiring exceptional engineers, and of people who got measurably better working for them
  • Hands-on. This person can still write the code, not only review it (and will get on the tools when the need arises)

Nice-to-have:

  • A sense of how hardware works: firmware, embedded systems, IoT, and shipping software for physical products
  • Experience in a client services environment (a consultancy, agency or studio)
  • Experience in a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect role
  • Open source projects they've started or maintained
  • Experience fostering close collaboration between design and engineering teams
  • Experience inside a worker-owned, open-book, or otherwise unusual company
  • A network in the engineering community: the meetups, the conferences, the people worth hiring
  • Interests in design, art, music, food or fashion. We find these people have a well rounded sense of quality

Who you are

The person weâre looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with and appreciates a commitment to a culture of transparency, non-dictatorial leadership styles, and alternative methodologies. Theyâre flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work âsmartâ by carefully managing their workflow and team.

How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, weâll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where weâre going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

Compensation

This is a permanent leadership role. If this individual exceeds expectations in their first four months, we'll shape the permanent role together, with scope and compensation that grow as the studios and their revenue do. After a period of proven success (12 - 24 months), they become eligible to join our worker ownership program.

We start with a 4-month fraction trial contract, paid hourly between $110 - $175 p/hr pending seniority & experience. In the first few weeks of the trial, this individual will propose their own goals to define success in their trial, and present them to our leadership team for approval.

At garden3d, we believe that those who shoulder the most responsibility and create the greatest impact should be paid accordingly. This role greatly favors autonomous, competent & ambitious operators.

â How we work:

We believe that thereâs a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason we work differently to most shops:

  • Transparency & Ownership:Â We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. Weâre proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.
  • 150% Carbon Negative: Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021.
  • Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).
  • Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.
  • Remote Friendly:Â Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.
  • Ideas & Products:Â In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

â Read more on our Substack, over here.

How to apply

Weâre excited to hear from you! â¤

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! :)

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Your Opportunity

As a Principal Engineer, you will help design, build, and operate the clinical decision support and API-driven data delivery platform that enables Vytalize Health to embed timely, actionable clinical insights directly into provider workflows. Working cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access dataâmoving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real-time APIs.

You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services

  • Own CDS Hook API contracts and evolution, ensuring compliance with SMART CDS Hooks specification while adding performance, reliability, and healthcare-specific optimizations

  • Lead technical integration with EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) for CDS Hook discovery, execution, card rendering, and user action handling

  • Design, build, and maintain public-facing REST and event-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider-facing applications

  • Establish API contracts, versioning strategies, and deprecation policies that balance innovation with stability for external consumers

  • Implement and maintain API security patterns including OAuth 2.0, scope-based authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging for compliant clinical data access

  • Design and optimize real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding CDS Hooks and APIsâensuring low latency, high freshness, and graceful failure modes

  • Design and implement comprehensive testing and QA frameworks for CDS Hooks and APIs â including hook context validation, card rendering verification, and clinical workflow testing across EMR systems

  • Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements

  • Define and measure clinical impact metrics â adoption of CDS Hooks, clinician interaction rates, workflow integration success, and patient outcome influence

  • Exercise architectural judgment across tradeoffs in correctness, latency, scalability, maintainability, and operational risk in clinical data systems

  • Design and implement reliability patterns for CDS and API services including monitoring, alerting, failure detection, graceful degradation, and incident recovery

  • Partner with Data Reliability Engineer to define and operate SLAs for CDS Hook delivery, API response times, and data freshness aligned to clinical needs

  • Establish and uphold engineering standards for API design, data schemas, integration patterns, and interoperability; maintain high-quality technical documentation and OpenAPI specifications

  • Partner with Data Engineering to align upstream data models, gold-layer datasets, and platform capabilities with clinical decision support and API requirements

  • Serve as the technical authority on clinical interoperability standards (SMART CDS Hooks, FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, EHR integration patterns)

  • Collaborate with Product, Clinical Operations, and Business stakeholders to clarify requirements, translate clinical workflows into platform features, and shape product direction

  • Act as trusted technical advisor to EMR partners, healthcare systems, and external API consumers; ensure expectations and delivery are well-defined and predictable

  • Ensure all CDS and API services comply with healthcare security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (HIPAA, state regulations, payer mandates)

  • Partner with IT Security and Compliance teams to implement secure access controls, audit logging, encryption, and data protection measures across delivery mechanisms

  • Design and implement audit trails for all clinical data access; support compliance audits and regulatory reporting

  • Mentor team members through design reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance on clinical data integration and API design

  • Document new and existing systems, designs, processes, and procedures

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience designing, building, and operating API platforms, service-oriented systems, or backend infrastructure at scale

  • Demonstrated experience operating at a senior or staff-level individual contributor scope, owning complex systems end-to-end

title: Technical Customer Support
description:
QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢.

The Role

We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality.

You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to.

Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are.

The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking.

This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer.

We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it.

If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

What Work Looks Like

You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable.

Every day

  • Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it.
  • Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution.
  • Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform.

Delighting customers

  • Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success.
  • Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked.
  • Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates.

Making support smarter with AI

  • Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off.
  • Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do.
  • Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving.

Keeping the product solid

  • Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected.
  • Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors.
  • Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice.

Running the week

  • Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated.
  • Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps.

Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude.

Who You Are

  • You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls.
  • You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things.
  • You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding.
  • You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom.
  • Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said.
  • You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity.
  • You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results.
  • You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack.
  • Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive.
  • Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are.

A Plus If You Have

  • Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role.
  • Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps.
  • Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client.
  • Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report.
  • An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment.

How We Work Together

You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer.

Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask.
  • Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt.
  • Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked.
  • The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on.
  • The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you.

This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once.

Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too.

Benefits

  • Contract type: full-time or part-time
  • Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099).
  • Start date: negotiable

About the job

Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

description:
Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity

Reports To: Vice President, Operations

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties:

  • Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management
  • Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes
  • Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements
  • Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff
  • Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA
  • Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities
  • Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights
  • Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise
  • Interact directly with customers as needed
  • Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others
  • Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs
  • Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement:

  • B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation
  • 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment
  • Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements
  • Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis
  • Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights
  • Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers
  • Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items
  • Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines
  • Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business.

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. Experience:

  • Proven experience leading Quality Management Review, internal audit programs, supplier management processes, and validation oversight.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
INNERGY is transforming the woodworking industry with purpose built, cloud based ERP software designed exclusively for custom manufacturers. Our platform helps businesses operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently while seamlessly connecting design, production, and delivery for teams creating architectural millwork, cabinetry, and casework.

What truly sets INNERGY apart is our people. Founded in 2016, we are a globally distributed team of 200 plus professionals united by deep software expertise and a shared passion for solving meaningful, real world problems. We value collaboration, creativity, and ownership, and we are intentional about building not only powerful products, but also a culture where people feel supported, heard, and inspired to do their best work.

With strong momentum and the recent acquisition of Microvellum, a trusted leader in design to manufacturing solutions for the woodworking industry, INNERGY is entering an exciting new phase of growth. This combination expands our capabilities, deepens our industry impact, and accelerates our vision of delivering a truly connected, end to end platform for custom manufacturers.

As we scale thoughtfully and bring together top talent and new perspectives, this is a unique opportunity to join a company where your work will have visible impact, your ideas will help shape decisions, and your contributions will play a meaningful role in defining the future of a fast evolving product, team, and industry.

Job Description

We're looking for a versatile, hands-on Marketing Specialist who thrives as a generalist and can move fluidly between product marketing content, web production, and performance channels. You'll be the kind of marketer who can write a compelling product page in the morning, build and publish it in WordPress over lunch, and optimize a paid search and social campaign by the afternoon. You're equally comfortable thinking about messaging and positioning as you are reading a CPL report.

This is a high-impact role for someone who wants ownership across the funnel and the chance to directly influence pipeline at a fast-growing vertical SaaS company. If you like wearing multiple hats, learning a niche industry deeply, and seeing your work drive measurable results, you'll fit right in.

Duties & Responsibilities include:

Product & content marketing

  • Translate product features and capabilities into clear, benefit-driven messaging that resonates with millwork and cabinetry business owners.
  • Write and produce marketing content across formats â landing pages, web copy, emails, case studies, one-pagers, ad copy, and campaign assets.
  • Partner with product and sales to keep positioning sharp and messaging consistent across the buyer journey.

Web production (WordPress)

  • Build, edit, and publish web pages in WordPress â from landing pages to product and resource pages â with an eye for layout, conversion, and on-page experience.
  • Maintain and improve the website over time: updating content, fixing issues, A/B testing, and ensuring pages stay fast, on-brand, and conversion-ready.

Paid social & paid search

  • Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid campaigns across search (Google Ads) and social (LinkedIn, Meta, and others as relevant).
  • Own day-to-day campaign management: audiences, creative, budgets, bidding, and ongoing testing to improve cost-per-lead and ROAS.
  • Report on performance and translate results into clear next steps.

Demand generation

  • Support full-funnel demand gen programs that drive leads and pipeline â across email, webinars, events, content syndication, and nurture.
  • Help build and execute integrated campaigns from concept through measurement.
  • Track and report on funnel metrics, contributing to a continuous test-and-learn culture.

Knowledge and Preferred Qualifications:

  • Attention to detail sets you apart. Youâll be working across multiple projects at once, and get to be responsible for delivering them with a high standard of quality
  • Youâre organized, efficient and deadline driven
  • Experience marketing to manufacturers, the construction/building products space, or other niche/vertical industries.
  • Familiarity with marketing automation and CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce).
  • Comfort with analytics tools (GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio) and ad platforms' native reporting.
  • Basic design or creative production skills (Canva, Figma, Adobe Creative Suite).
  • Experience with webinars, events, or field marketing.

Qualifications

  • Ability to travel for maximum of one week at a time. Both domestic and international travel may be required. A valid US passport will be required, if not already in place. Weekend travel may be required during conventions and shows.
  • Your position is not expected to require a significant amount of travel, but we expect that you might be on the road up to 20% of your time.
  • Ability to sit for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to work / look at a monitor for extended periods of time.
  • Ability to lift 45lbs or less.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Accessibility & Work Environment

INNERGY is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace. We support reasonable adjustments for individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process or in your role, please let us know.

This role is primarily computer-based and may involve extended periods of screen time and frequent communication through digital tools. Work may be performed remotely or in an office setting, depending on the role and location. We prioritize employee wellbeing, flexibility, and a safe, supportive work environment across all regions.

Equal Opportunity Employer

INNERGY is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity at every level of the organization. We are committed to creating a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Location Eligibility Notice

This is a U.S.-based remote role. Due to current regulatory requirements, we are only able to consider candidates residing in certain U.S. states.

Eligible states include, but are not limited to: Texas, Florida, Missouri, Arizona, Indiana, North Carolina, and Wisconsin.

At this time, candidates located in California, Colorado, New York, Illinois, Washington, or other states with active pay transparency requirements are not eligible for consideration.

title: Senior Legal Counsel, Product
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Job Description

🎯 You will be a trusted legal partner to our Product and R&D leadership and teams, as our privacy and product counsel. As such you will specifically be supporting our Product and R&D teams, developing further our readiness for AI regulation and advising on wider digital regulatory requirements, to allow n8n to keep building and be early. You will also help shape a modern, AI-first legal strategy as part of a growing Legal team, and bring your product insight to the technology and commercial deals where it makes the difference. You will report to the General Counsel.

What success looks like after 6 months: you are the go-to legal partner in Product and R&D roadmap, you design and launch reviews, our AI regulation readiness plan is in place with clear owners, and templates and playbooks are updated so the wider Legal team can run standard deals without R&D and Product related escalation.

Responsibilities:

Partner with Product and R&D (c. 80% of the role)

  • Partner with the existing Legal team to build out our current approach to AI regulation: EU AI Act readiness and risk classification, AI risk assessments, model and provider due diligence, AI use policies, and customer-facing AI transparency commitments.

  • Partner with others in the Legal team on our response to the wider digital regulatory landscape for software (for example the EU Data Act, and other digital regulation), from horizon scanning through to product readiness and compliance roadmaps.

  • Be the embedded Product and Engineering partner, joining roadmap, design and launch reviews, advising on platform and product terms from the design stage, and turning legal requirements into clear product requirements engineers can build against.

  • Advise on open-source, fair-code and open-core licensing, and on IP questions around AI-generated outputs, machine learning models and training data.

  • Partner with others in the Legal team on privacy questions that arise in product design.

  • Support Product and Engineering with customer, community and regulator questions about how our products meet legal requirements.

Support complex technology and commercial deals (c. 20% of the role)

  • Review, draft and negotiate technology-heavy agreements (SaaS and self-hosted), partnership and integration, and AI model and cloud provider contracts.

  • Partner with sales, partnerships and revenue teams on complex enterprise deals with AI or product requirements.

  • Deliver creative, risk-based solutions that protect the business, and feed deal learnings back into product decisions.

Scale legal as a business enabler

  • Solve legal questions in real time with a builder mindset.

  • Improve and maintain scalable legal templates, playbooks and training materials together with the Legal team, so that standard deals and product questions do not need legal involvement, so the wider Legal team can run standard deals without escalation.

  • Collaborate with our Automation and Legal Operations to improve our self-serve legal processes and tooling.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • ⚖️ Qualified lawyer (Europe-based): You are a qualified legal professional with 5+ years' post-qualification experience (PQE), with at least 3 of those years within an in-house SaaS or technology environment with a start up or scale up company.

  • 💬 Fluent English: You can clearly communicate legal nuance in plain terms to global stakeholders.

  • 🤖 Product, AI and digital regulation expert: You have substantial, hands-on experience of acting as a trusted business partner to and advising technology teams on regulatory matters such as the EU AI Act and related digital regulation and a clear track record of getting up to speed on new regulation quickly.

  • 🔓 Open-source and licensing: You have working knowledge of open-source, fair-code or open-core licensing and how it applies to software products.

  • 🌍 Cross-functional collaborator: You have experience supporting engineers, product managers and sales teams, and can demonstrate how you balance legal risk with product and revenue goals.

  • 🛠️ Builder mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity, enjoy solving problems with and without a playbook, and look for ways to improve how legal works.

  • 🏃 Fast-scaling environment experience: You have worked where priorities shift quickly and your impact is immediate.

  • 📄 Commercial and technology contracts: You have solid working experience with SaaS and self-hosted software license agreements.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🧠 Curiosity for tech and automation: You are excited to experiment with legal tech, AI tools and scalable internal systems.

  • 🎓 AI or technology law credentials: for example AIGP, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 💬 Other Languages: You can communicate in German with customers and stakeholders.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into a shared drive. It will shape how a category-defining company builds products and does deals. You will be embedded with Product and R&D, with commercial work where your product expertise matters most. You will join a senior Legal team, helping embed AI-first thinking into everything we do, in a fast-growing, remote-first team that values ownership, pragmatism and speed.

Sound like a challenge you are excited to take on? Apply now, and help us build the future of automation. If you meet most but not all of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

*Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role


You will own how Orbem shows up at customer sites — installing, servicing, and maintaining multi-million-euro imaging systems that sit at the heart of our customers’ production lines. When our systems run, our customers run. When they don’t, the cost is measured in lost production days. Field Operations is where our technology meets reality, and you own that interface.

Field Operations spans Europe and the US, with regional teams on both sides of the Atlantic. A lot has already been built: dedicated Field Engineers and Project Managers, regional leadership, and real investment in SOPs, planning, and tooling. The next step is maturity — turning what exists into an operation that runs consistently across every site, every partner, and every geography, and that scales without depending on individual heroics.

You inherit that and the mandate to shape what comes next. We are expanding fast into new verticals and geographies, and installation and service quality is one of the few things that can either unlock or throttle that growth. This is a role for someone equally at home setting the operating model and being close to the work itself — credible with a customer's engineers and with our executive team on the same day — and who is unwilling to let the same problem happen twice.


Your Day to Day

Running Operations (≈ 40%)

  • Be the escalation point that actually resolves things — including on site, out of hours, when a go-live is at risk.

Building the Operating System (≈ 35%)

  • Raise SOP maturity — across our own team, our partners, and our customers’ contractors.

  • Implement a continuous improvement engine together with the Operational Excellence team.

  • Build the quality and safety standards our engineers work to, and hold the line on them under schedule pressure.

 

Leading and Scaling the Team (≈ 25%)

  • Lead and develop the whole team — Field Engineers, Project Managers, and regional leads alike — building the depth and ownership that lets each region run well without you in the detail.

  • Design the organisation ahead of the growth curve: hire, structure, and re-structure as we add verticals and geographies, and find the right mix of own team, partner networks, and variable capacity models to absorb fluctuating demand.

  • Define and operationalize the Field Operations roadmap, and translate it into a capacity and hiring plan the business can commit to.

  • Build the culture: high standards, low ego, no blame, and a bias toward fixing things properly.

How You Fit In

  • You report to the Chief Operating Officer and lead Field Operations through two regional team leads, with Field Engineers delivering installation, on-site service, and maintenance work and Project Managers coordinating customers, partners, and internal teams. The team will keep growing as we roll out new geographies and products.

  • You work closely with Technical Customer Support, Operational Excellence, Supply Chain, Hardware, Product, and Business Development, and you own our operational relationship with our equipment and automation partners.

  • You are part of the wider operations leadership team and contribute to decisions well beyond your own function.


Your Experiences and Skills

  • 10+ years in field or service operations. You have led installation, on-site service, and maintenance operations for complex technical products.

  • Hardware plus service business models. You understand a business where the machine is only half the promise and installation, uptime, and maintenance are the other half.

  • Practicalities. Willingness to travel to European and US sites, and an EU Class B driver’s licence. Fluent in English; additional languages (German, Spanish, Italian, French) are a plus.


What Makes You Stand Out

Unsere large-scale Softwareprodukte werden täglich von Millionen von Benutzern verwendet und sind entscheidend für den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg unserer Kunden. Jedes Produkt ist somit geschäftskritisch und ist von strategischer Relevanz. 

Gemeinsam machen wir “mission impossible possible”. 

Unser Team besteht aus 300+ Members aus der ganzen Welt. In unseren Büros in Hamburg und Lissabon bauen wir gemeinsam Produkte, die noch nie jemand zuvor entwickelt hat.

Unsere Teams arbeiten datengetrieben, um ihre eigene Produktivität ständig zu optimieren. Jedes Teammitglied übernimmt die “end-to-end” Verantwortung für seine Arbeit. Um erfolgreich zu sein, muss man produktiv sein. Um produktiv zu sein, muss man effizient und effektiv sein.

Technology never rests. Neither do we.


ÜBER DEINEN JOB
  • Wir sind der festen Überzeugung, dass Sicherheit ein technisches Thema ist. Deshalb glauben wir, dass nur ein echter Engineer für die Sicherheit bei freiheit.com verantwortlich sein kann. Nur wenn Du weißt, wie die Dinge funktionieren, kannst Du Prozesse und Richtlinien entwerfen, um uns und unsere Daten sicher und geschützt zu halten.
  • Du entwirfst und implementierst die Infrastruktur, damit Du einfache, aber dennoch zuverlässige und sichere Prozesse sowie Richtlinien einführen kannst.
  • Da Du von Herzen Engineer bist, schreibst Du Code, um manuelle Aufgaben zu automatisieren. Du weißt sowieso, dass es der einzige Weg ist.
  • Du bist aber auch für unser ISMS (Information Security Management System) verantwortlich und sorgst dafür, dass dieses stets auf dem neuesten Stand ist und die Regeln und Vorschriften im ISMS sinnvoll und hilfreich sind. Ebenso arbeitest Du mit unserem Datenschutzbeauftragten zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass wir die DSGVO einhalten.
  • Du stärkst unsere Mitglieder auch, indem Du ihnen Sicherheit beibringst. Sowohl durch die Gestaltung von Schulungen als auch durch die Unterstützung bei der Schaffung einer sicheren Infrastruktur in ihren Projekten.
  • Das Jobprofil ist eine tolle Chance für Software Engineers, die ihr Spektrum in Richtung Sicherheit und Compliance erweitern und zudem strategisch arbeiten möchten.
  • Wir glauben auch, dass eine kleine Dosis Zwangsstörung hilfreich sein könnte ;-). Zumindest solltest Du den starken Willen haben, die Dinge richtig zu machen, und sehr sorgfältig bei Deiner Arbeit sein.

    • ÜBER DICH
    Qualifikationen:
  • Bachelor-Abschluss in Informatik oder verwandten Bereichen wie Mathematik, Physik oder Elektrotechnik
  • Erfahrung mit Docker und Kubernetes
  • Erfahrung in der UNIX-Systemadministration und Networking
  • Programmiererfahrung – idealerweise in Go
  • Hoher Einfluss auf den technischen Erfolg Deiner vergangenen Projekte
  • Die Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mind. C1) und verhandlungssicheres Englisch. 
    • Bonus Skills and Interessen:
  • Master oder Doktortitel in Informatik oder verwandten Bereichen wie Mathematik oder Physik
  • Erfahrung in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS) oder Microsoft Azure
  • Erfahrung mit Observability (Protokollierung, Überwachung, Alarmierung, Rückverfolgung)
  • Erfahrung mit Security
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit verteilten Systemen in der Cloud (Terraform)
  • Erfahrung im Einrichten von CI/CD-Pipelines

    • ÜBER UNSERE COMMUNITY

    Auf die Frage, warum jemand hier arbeitet, lautet die Antwort oft: „wegen der Menschen“ und „weil ich in meinem Leben noch nie so viel gelernt habe“.

    Wir glauben, dass produktive Menschen glückliche Menschen sind. 

    In unseren Engineering Hubs in Hamburg und Lissabon triffst du auf Menschen aus der ganzen Welt. 

    Hier hast du die Möglichkeit, mit intelligenten Menschen an spannenden Aufgaben zu arbeiten und Projekte von der Idee bis zur Auslieferung umzusetzen – end-to-end. 

    Ein wahrer Experte in seinem Fachgebiet wird man nicht über Nacht – dazu braucht es Jahre harter Arbeit und kontinuierliches Lernen. Als ein Member unserer Community wird viel von dir verlangt, und niemand kann die Arbeit für dich übernehmen.

    Unser Unternehmen ist ein Ort, an dem du die beste Version deiner selbst werden kannst. 

    ***Wir bieten keine reinen Remote-Stellen an. Wir arbeiten fünf Tage pro Woche im Büro. 

    DAZUGEHÖREN?

    Dann schicke uns Deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse) über unser Bewerberportal. Und bei Fragen zu Deiner Bewerbung oder dem Bewerbungsprozess steht Dir Bianca Mioc unter +49 40/890584-0 persönlich zur Verfügung.

title: Account Executive DACH - SMB (m/f/d)
description:
About Agicap
 
Created in Lyon in 2016 by three French entrepreneurs, Agicap is one of the fastest scale-ups in Europe, with over 8000 customers, 650 employees and fast revenue growth (7x between 2021 and 2024). Agicap is part of the French Tech 120, rewarding the most promising startups in France.
 
Agicap allows Finance teams of Mid-Market companies to efficiently manage and forecast their cash, pay their suppliers and get paid. By combining a Treasury Management System, and Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable solutions into a single platform, Agicap aims at becoming the next leading Treasury Management platform for mid-market companies.
 
We have raised €145M since our creation, with prestigious VC funds including AVP, Greenoaks, Partech and BlackFin, with a last round in November 2024.
 
These additional resources further fuel our product innovation, allowing us to grow significantly and accelerate our international expansion across the world.
 
We believe our success comes from our highly passionate and dedicated teams, committed to building a company where people can grow and build their careers. We are constantly looking for great talents, aiming for excellence and ready to join our ambitious adventure!
 
Home page
Customer Stories
Our Values

About the Account Executive - SMB role:

We are growing our team in Düsseldorf! Working closely with the Business Development team, Outbound SDRs, Inbound SDRs and Partnership Managers on a daily basis, your mission will be to generate new business by acquiring new clients.

As an SMB Account Executive at Agicap, you will drive sales and expand our customer base within the SMB segment. You will play a crucial role in identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with potential clients and closing deals in order to achieve your sales targets.


You will be responsible for:
  • Defining and implementing a sectoral development strategy with your SDRs.
  • Identifying and targeting SMB companies that could benefit from Agicap’s financial management solutions.
  • Conducting product demonstrations and presentations to showcase the value of Agicap’s offerings.
  • Developing and maintaining a robust sales pipeline through prospecting, networking, and referrals.
  • Building and nurturing relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers within target organizations.
  • Negotiating contracts and closing sales to meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets.
  • Staying informed about industry developments, competitor activities, and market trends.
  • Regularly monitoring and analyzing your performance with Management to identify areas for improvement.
  • Providing feedback to the Marketing, Business Development, and Product teams to improve processes and the product.
  • Sharing your commercial expertise and good ideas to enhance the team’s performance.

    • What we are looking for:
  • Native/Bilingual level of German
  • 2-4 years of experience in B2B Sales, preferably in the SaaS industry and with mid-market space, and with some experience working in a finance department/audit/consulting/TS.
  • Studies background in a top business or Engineering school.
  • A passion for sales and a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets.
  • A tenacious, resilient salesperson who never gives up and is driven by results.
  • Someone who can put themselves in the shoes of business leaders to understand their current and future cash flow needs.
  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, excellent verbal communication, and a high level of intellectual curiosity.
  • Great ambition, with the drive to meet and even exceed objectives.
  • A strong business acumen and above-average interpersonal skills.
  • A team spirit and a desire to share knowledge, helping colleagues grow.

    • 7 Reasons to Join Agicap as an AE:
  • Exceptional product-market fit, confirmed by our latest funding round:
  • Crucial need → cash = the lifeblood of business, top priority for CFOs (PwC)
  • Strongly differentiated solution, leader in Europe (G2)
  • Gigantic market: over 350k companies in DACH alone
  • Unique company culture: meritocracy, high standards, continuous learning, European scale-up (>50% revenue outside France)
  • Opportunities for functional and geographical growth
  • Strong financial situation
  • Team of rockstars, friendly and skilled
  • A growth engine of a large Outbound SDR team, Inbound & Partner leads to help you scale fast!
  • Competitive package - with uncapped commissions!

    • Our benefits:
    - Competitive Compensation: Attractive package including both fixed and variable components.
    - Professional Development: Access a “Mini-MBA” with a focus on Finance & Treasury via the Agicap Academy.
    - Global Collaboration: Join a diverse international team with occasional trips to our headquarters in France.
    - Meal & Grocery Allowance: Receive up to €108/month tax-free for lunch or groceries, easily managed via the Hrmony app.
    - Tenure Rewards: Enjoy a €30 monthly shopping voucher after one year and up to two additional vacation days based on your length of service.
    - Team culture: Join us and be part of a dynamic environment, enjoying global offsites such as our recent annual seminar on a French island, as well as local team events.
    AGICAP is committed to providing equal opportunities for everyone, and we foster an inclusive work environment that values diversity!

title: MS Dynamics Senior Functional Manager
description:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?

We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe. 

Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. 

It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. 

Ready to awaken your best with us? 


We are looking for a passionate, highly motivated Senior MS Dynamics Functional Manager to help shape and scale our Finance and Supply Chain systems, working hands-on across the ERP landscape to turn business needs into robust, maintainable ERP solution.

What you'll do:
  • Collaborate with the team & stakeholders to gather and validate requirements across the Finance and Supply Chain domains (R2R, O2C, P2P).  
  • Analyze business processes and contribute to the design of ERP solutions that are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business goals. 
  • Translate business needs into clear functional specifications and configuration inputs.
  • Ensure that functional deliverables meet quality standards and align with ERP configuration best practices. 
  • Produce clear and comprehensive documentation of future-state business processes to support solution design, stakeholder alignment, and long-term maintainability.   
  • Perform functional testing of developed features and support go-live readiness activities, including user training, documentation, and post-deployment validation.  
  • Identify and recommend opportunities for continuous improvement in business processes and system usage.
    •  

    What we're looking for:
  • Hands-on experience in ERP systems, with strong functional expertise in one or more of the following domains: Record to Report (R2R), Order to Cash (O2C), or Procure to Pay (P2P).  
  • Previous experience working with Microsoft Dynamics (either Business Central or Finance & Operations) is a must.
  • Proven ability to gather and analyse business requirements and translate them into effective ERP configurations and process improvements.
  • Skilled in documenting business processes and functional designs in a clear, structured, and maintainable format
  • Experience in functional testing, including test case creation and validation of system behavior.
  • Comfortable working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments and actively participating in ceremonies such as planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to tailor the speech according to the audience to work effectively across cross-functional business and technical teams.
  • Detail-oriented and quality-focused, with a commitment to delivering consistent, high-standard functional outputs.
  • Professional fluency in English.

    • What we offer:
  • Maturing Scale-Up: We’re part of the 13–20% of start-ups that transition to scale-up. This is a rare stage where we refine systems without losing agility. It’s where start-up energy meets scalable impact - and where people can build the next version of Emma.
  • Empowerment to Impact: Every Emmie owns part of our success with accountability. It’s about seeing it, owning it, doing it – something that is valued and measured in development.
  • Growth & Learning Journey: We live by the 70/20/10 model – with 70% on the job, 20% from others, 10% structured training. We invest in your growth with trainings and coaching to get you to the top of your game.
  • Emma-zing Community: We hire selectively which means working with smart, collaborative people who care deeply. It’s a community built by Emmies for Emmies.
  • Next Level Global: With 60+ nationalities across 4 offices, global collaboration is part of our values. You’ll work across cultures, perspectives, and time zones.
  • Flexibility: Our Technology team's remote work policy allows for great flexibility. (Please note that the role requires being based in Portugal or Germany)

    • Become an Emmie 

    We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.  

    We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age. 

    Our aim is to get back to you within a few days. Due to the high volume of applications, there may be slight delays, but we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.
